summary: Log cupola lookout cabin in Powell County, MT, dated 1922 and destroyed 1958; a 1960 survey description records the burned remains on the south hill.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1958 per firelookout.com; a 1960 survey description records remains of a burned cabin; Montanalookouts says removed with no date.

events.note: firelookout.com dates a log cupola cabin to 1922
firelookout.com says destroyed in 1958; Montanalookouts lists it as removed, undated
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description (quoted on Montanalookouts) records remains of a burned lookout cabin on the south hill

evidence.supports: about 24 miles east of Seeley Lake, in Powell County
firelookout.com lists the Lolo and Helena National Forests together
Lake Mountain is in Powell County, Montana
Helena National Forest listed as agency
Montanalookouts lists the site as removed, no date
1960 survey description: the south hill is the highest and holds the remains of a burned lookout cabin
evidence.quote: THE SOUTH ONE IS THE HIGHEST, AND HAS THE REMAINS OF A BURNED LOOKOUT CABIN.

evidence.supports: station described by the Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1960
evidence.quote: DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1960 (OSR)

evidence.supports: survey description notes a helicopter landing on the cabin site
evidence.quote: THERE IS A GOOD COPTER LANDING ON THE SITE OF THE BURNED LOOKOUT CABIN.

evidence.supports: Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the site ground gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com names the Lolo and Helena National Forests together; Montanalookouts names only the Helena. The facts record Helena as the agency from Montanalookouts; the story reports both pages.

sources.title: Lake Mountain - Forest Lookouts (quotes a National Geodetic Survey station description)

notes_for_editor: Brief checked: status gone, kind ground (log cupola cabin) and Helena NF agree with the Montanalookouts page; firelookout.com also names Lolo NF, recorded as a resolved conflict. No corrections. The 1960 National Geodetic Survey station description is quoted on the Montanalookouts page; no NGS datasheet URL was fetched, so it is cited to that page. No builder, staffing or fire record was found. Worth checking: the NGS datasheet for PID ST0528 for a newer description, and Helena NF records.
